operators.name: D1.v1-retarget-connect
operators.description: connect edge retargeted from a Port to a Component (original operator)

operators.name: D1.retarget-allocate
operators.description: allocate edge of a Function retargeted to a Port

operators.name: D1.reverse-satisfy
operators.description: satisfy edge reversed (Requirement -> Component)

operators.name: D1.add-illegal-pair
operators.description: new edge of a random type between a type pair the catalog does not allow

operators.name: D2.v1-drop-sole-verify
operators.description: sole verify edge of a Requirement deleted, verification case keeps another edge (original operator)

operators.name: D2.drop-sole-verify-any
operators.description: sole verify edge of a Requirement deleted at any position (side effects allowed)

operators.name: D2.drop-sole-satisfy
operators.description: sole satisfy edge of a Requirement deleted

operators.name: D2.extra-allocate
operators.description: second allocate edge added to a Function (upper bound 1 exceeded)

operators.name: D2.extra-port-owner
operators.description: second owning contain edge added to a Port (upper bound 1 exceeded)

operators.name: D2.extra-subject
operators.description: second subject edge added to a View (upper bound 1 exceeded)

operators.name: D3.v1-unset-component-attr
operators.description: second required attribute of a Component removed (original operator)

operators.name: D3.unset-any
operators.description: a random required attribute of a node of any type removed

operators.name: D4.v1-negative-mass
operators.description: Component mass set to -1 (original operator)

operators.name: D4.outside
operators.description: value outside the enumeration / negative / empty string, on a random domain attribute

operators.name: D4.upper
operators.description: range attribute set to max + 0.01 (boundary)

operators.name: D4.lower
operators.description: range attribute set to min - 0.01 (boundary)

operators.name: D4.typeMismatch
operators.description: value of the wrong primitive type (string for range, number for enum, number for string)

operators.name: D5.v1-drop-satisfy
operators.description: sole satisfy edge of a function-hosting Component deleted, requirement keeps another satisfier (original operator)

operators.name: D5.drop-all-satisfy
operators.description: all satisfy edges of a function-hosting Component deleted (side effects allowed)

operators.name: D5.retarget-allocate-unsatisfying
operators.description: allocate edge of a Function moved to a Component without any satisfy edge

operators.name: D6.v1-reverse-edge
operators.description: reverse dependOn edge added (2-cycle, original operator)

operators.name: D6.close-long-path
operators.description: dependOn path of length >= 2 closed into a cycle

operators.name: D6.self-loop
operators.description: dependOn self loop on a Component

operators.name: D7.v1-new-interface
operators.description: new isolated Interface (original operator)

operators.name: D7.new-other-type
operators.description: new isolated node of another non-isolated type with valid attributes (side effects allowed)

operators.name: D7.detach-existing
operators.description: all relationships of an existing node deleted

operators.name: D8.v1-expose-foreign-port
operators.description: non-subject expose edge of a View moved to a Port of another component (original operator)

operators.name: D8.add-expose-foreign-component
operators.description: expose edge added from a View to a Component outside its subject scope

operators.name: D8.retarget-subject
operators.description: subject edge of a View moved to another Component (existing exposures fall out of scope)

partA.design: single defect per model; every operator x degree tier (periphery <= p50 < core < p90 <= hub; new-node operators form tier "new"); oracle = reference semantics of the single-defect model minus base; FP = engine keys outside expected and base

partB.design: one candidate pool per run, evaluated with the non-interference scheduler (scheduled) and without it (ablation); oracle = base u union of isolated expectations

partC.note: the overall rate is a convex combination of per-type rates; any value in overallRange is attainable by choosing the mixture

partD.description: base = clean model + 2 random change sets (2% of nodes each); generalized equation Omega*(M_faulty) = Omega*(M_base) disjoint-union U_i (Omega*(M_di) minus Omega*(M_base))
